title: Google Analytics sync retrying on invalid runReport request
answers: Why does Google Analytics sync keep retrying on 400 Bad Request?
How to handle invalid custom report dimensions or metrics in GA4 warehouse sync?
Why does Temporal exhaust retries on Google Analytics runReport client errors?
body:
Symptom: Google Analytics data warehouse sync repeatedly retries and exhausts retry budget when custom reports contain invalid metric or dimension names.
Root cause: products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/sources/google_analytics/source.py:GoogleAnalyticsSource.get_non_retryable_errors omitted 400 Bad Request for the GA4 Data API, allowing deterministic client errors to be retried.
Fix pattern: Add the host-scoped 400 error string to get_non_retryable_errors with actionable user guidance on schema requirements.
Constraints: Applies only to deterministic client errors like schema or field misconfigurations; transient errors and quota exhaustion must remain retryable.
says: Google Analytics data import gets stuck retrying when report dimensions are invalid
Warehouse synchronization with Google Analytics should fail fast on bad report schemas
Sync retry budget exhausted on custom Google Analytics report with unknown metrics
Show clear configuration error instead of endlessly retrying broken Google Analytics sync
